scope: Independent server restarts and warmups for each of three repetitions; order rotated within matched blocks. Medians and ranges summarize repetitions, not confidence intervals.

resource_definitions.summary: For every added point statistic, median/min/max summarize three retained repetitions; n is the repetition count.
resource_definitions.point_energy: gpu_energy_wh_per_request is the retained rounded workload-level statistic. It must not be inverted to reconstruct runtime or substituted for the unrounded full-workload calculation.
resource_definitions.full_workload: At concurrency 64, device-hours per million = wall_seconds / 192 * 1,000,000 / 3,600. GPU kWh per million = that value * mean_gpu_power_watts / 1,000. Calculate each repetition first, then summarize. The complete 192-request workload includes ramp-down; the displayed throughput estimator excludes ramp-down.
resource_definitions.energy_scope: GPU telemetry only, excluding CPU and other system components. These short warmed-workload extrapolations are not sustained production costs or whole-system energy.
resource_definitions.kv_cache_scope: Reported token capacity, not deployment memory consumption or production capacity.
